description: Synthetic production-style simulation, not a measured production trace

interpretation.primary_target: Total first-text delay >=300 seconds. A clean full 300-second pending-text cancellation is right-censored binary late, never an exact 300-second TTFT.
interpretation.stream: Cancel only while first text is absent at 300 seconds; after first text, allow the capped 32-token response to finish until the independent 420-second response horizon.
interpretation.history: Fresh owned router and initial native idle/empty history, then bounded 60-second learning. Preserve the current trained epoch into immediate pressure; no quiet ramps or forced drain at entry.
interpretation.workload: Long-prefill ramp; changed from previous longdecode tests. No historical causal comparison.
interpretation.baseline_seed: Prior to each focused main case, run representative sequential seed profile; configure medianSMGfirsttext with frozen raw/model/runtime provenance.
interpretation.template_labels: Cohort names are prompttemplate keys. All main inputs are standardized longprefill16–32kwords with32outputtokens; labels do not imply actualshortchat/longdecode or representativeproductionmix. No answerquality claim.
interpretation.recovery: Undrained 720-second scheduled recovery requests continue beyond the 300/420-second feedback bounds. Later natural drain resets are recorded, not called fit convergence.
interpretation.isolation: Ownedephemeralservingkeyauth beforeadmission, no rawkeyinPodspec/config/logs. Missing/wrongkey401+correctinvalidbody400controls beforeSTART; finalwhole-captureexactrequest-IDaudit. Engine/directbypass notcovered.
interpretation.comparison: Scalar, deadline-conditioned feature and live-v2 are compared on the same admissions within this arm. Different cancellation policies change traffic, so cross-arm differences are descriptive and not a causal per-request treatment effect.
interpretation.features: Neutral initialization and unchanged fit/slew constants. Separate actual terminal cutoff counters from deduplicated 300-second deadline-or-cutoff outcomes.
